about.heading: Why INOK
body: INOK stands for Idhu Namme Oru Kedai, Tamil for "this is our shop". Every participant came with a business of their own, and every lesson was about growing it.

Small businesses in the Malaysian Indian community often have strong products but little time or support to take them online. INOK was designed to change that: practical digital-marketing skills, taught in person, then applied to each participant's own business with a mentor alongside.

The 2024 Program Pensijilan Digital Marketing Strategist was delivered by GET Academy under a programme funded by MITRA (Malaysian Indian Community Transformation Unit), with certification through SEGi University.
about._note: Second paragraph names MITRA and SEGi factually (no logos, no endorsement). Confirm wording with the user before launch.

funding.heading: Funded by MITRA
funding.body: MITRA, the Malaysian Indian Community Transformation Unit (Unit Transformasi Masyarakat India Malaysia), is a Malaysian government unit that supports education, skills and business programmes for the Indian community. In 2024 it funded the Digital Marketing Strategist Certification Programme, which GET Academy delivered for micro-entrepreneurs and small businesses.
funding._note: Logo renders only if logo-mitra exists on disk. No ministry name, funding amounts or endorsement wording here (CLAUDE.md). MITRA permission is still pending in CLAUDE.md.

why.heading: Why this programme
why.body: The programme taught small business owners to sell online using TikTok, e-commerce platforms and AI tools. It ran over 26 days: six face-to-face in Ipoh, then 20 days of mentored online work.

curriculum.intro: Every module ended with participants applying it to their own business.

steps.title: Day 1: Strategy and foundations
steps.text: Mentored discussions on goals, customers and positioning.

steps.title: Day 2: Building your presence
steps.text: Hands-on setup of business pages and digital tools.

steps.title: Days 3–6: Content, ads and e-commerce
steps.text: Video, social content, advertising and marketplace selling, practised on each participant's own business.

steps.title: 20 days of mentored implementation
steps.text: Participants put their plans to work online with continued guidance.
